correctness.rationale: For affine trial U containing x0, exact minimization of G(x)=||S(Tx−c)||² yields sketched normal-equation orthogonality <Sz,Sh>=0 with z=r(xhat), h=r(x0)−r(xhat). On residual span W, squared-norm 1±ε embedding with ε<1 makes S invertible onto SW; its inverse pullback metric M has eigenvalue interval [1/(1+ε),1/(1−ε)]. For G(xhat)>0 the sketched residuals Sz and Sh are orthogonal with ||Sh||²=δ||Sz||². Restriction to their 2D span makes normalized true change tr(MK), K=[[0,sqrt(δ)],[sqrt(δ),δ]], whose signed eigenvalues λ±=(δ±sqrt(δ(δ+4)))/2. Minimizing over all metrics in spectral box assigns max metric to negative eigendirection and min to positive, yielding exact lower envelope [δ−ε sqrt(δ(δ+4))]/(1−ε²). A two-row construction with S=M^-1/2 and r(x)=M^1/2(1,x sqrt δ) attains equality for EVERY ε,δ>0; rearrangement gives universal no-ascent threshold δ>=4ε²/(1−ε²). At δ=0, Sh=0 and embedding injectivity forces h=0; if G optimum=0 then F optimum=0. Independent exact rational two-row witness at ε=4/5,δ=9/4 yielded Ghat=1, G0=13/4, Fhat=37/9, F0=73/36, and F0−Fhat=−25/12, confirming sharp possible true ascent. Finite witness checks are not the all-ε,δ proof.
